newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokoku Sangyo plans third-party share allotment.
newsitem.headline: Hokoku Sangyo plans third-party share allotment.

text.p: Sewing threads maker Hokoku Sangyo Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would issue four million new shares through a third-party allotment in late March.
The new shares will be allotted to six Tokyo-based companies, Hokoku said in a statement.
Payment will be made on March 28, it said.
The company said its outstanding shares currently numbered four million.

Of the 1.2 billion yen to be raised through the new share issue, 1.05 billion yen will be used for its business and 125 million yen will be used to repay debts, the company said. The rest is the cost of issuing new shares, Hokoku said.
